blocks.text: Flexera allows enterprises to gain visibility and control of IT assets, which reduces ongoing software costs and maintains continuous license compliance.

The Flexera Assets connector retrieves detailed hardware, lifecycle, and ownership information for each asset in your organization, including unique identifiers (e.g., asset ID, computer ID, and asset tags) and specific hardware details (e.g., manufacturer, model number, and serial number).
The Flexera Assets source authentication configuration requires an API token.

blocks.item: Log in to one of the following URLs based on the server location of your account:
North American: Log in to app.flexera.com.
From the top right of the page, click the Profile menu.
From the left-side navigation, click API Credentials, then click Create API Refresh Token.
The New API Refresh Token window appears, displaying the generated refresh token.
Click Copy to copy the refresh token.
Save the refresh token securely as you cannot copy or view it later.

blocks.text: To create the Flexera Assets data source in the Zscaler Security Operations (SecOps) platform:

blocks.item: Search for and select the connector tile from the available data sources.

blocks.text: After you create the Flexera Assets data source, enter the following information in the source setup Retrieval section:

blocks.item: In the Authentication section, click Create New.
In the Flexera Authentication window, enter the information from the Prerequisites section.
To learn more, see Configuring Authentications and Managing Authentications.

Select one of the three available zones (i.e., US, EU, or APAC) from the drop-down menu according to the zone in which your user and tenant are provisioned. To learn more, refer to the Flexera documentation.
Enter the unique ID assigned to your Flexera organization.
Log in to the Flexera platform based on your server location.

Identify and copy the numeric identifier found at the end of the URL. For example, an organization in the NAM zone follows the format https://app.flexera.com/orgs/<org ID>/. So if your URL is https://app.flexera.com/orgs/30408/, then the organization ID is 30408.

blocks.text: For complete configuration instructions, see Creating Data Sources.
